blockers.description: The plan revision loop stalled because the latest checker found 3 blockers and 1 warning after the previous pass found 2 blockers and 1 warning.

blockers.description: Cross-plan Dashboard applied projection fields disagree with the required contract: plans use company_name/job_title instead of company/title.
blockers.workaround: Normalize SQL, parsers, catalog checks, hosted evidence, fixtures, and Dashboard consumers to company/title.

blockers.description: Manual draft plans permit editing the initial stage date before save, contrary to the approved UI-SPEC and D-14.
blockers.workaround: Keep p_occurred_on in the RPC but submit an automatically supplied current date; make it read-only until creation.

blockers.description: The fixture manifest requires literal application/event UUIDs that are generated by ordinary-session RPCs and therefore cannot be known when the checksum is approved.
blockers.workaround: Predeclare only seedable IDs, then derive an in-memory lineage allowlist from returned/queried IDs and constrain cleanup by owner, parent, namespace, and exact counts.

blockers.description: The fixture inventory says seven public tables plus auth.users, but actually lists six public tables plus auth.users.
blockers.workaround: Use the exact wording: six public tables plus auth.users, seven relations total.
